name: loom-runtime
description: loom's runtime piece: boxes and houses, model accounts, harness runners and model choice

loom.name: runtime
loom.label: Runtime
loom.description: The runtime: the machines (boxes) and containers (houses) agents run in, their model accounts, the harnesses that run a body, and which model it runs on.

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_LOOM_URL
settings.label: loom's MCP URL, as this machine reaches it

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_PUBLIC_URL
settings.label: loom's URL for other boxes
settings.hint: what a new box joins, e.g. https://loom.example.com

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_ACCOUNTS
settings.label: The accounts provider
settings.hint: the command that holds the household's model accounts, as a JSON argv (default ["loom", "subscriptions"]), or none

settings.name: LOOM_RUNTIME_TOKEN_FILE
settings.label: A runtime token, for reading scorecards
settings.hint: a file holding a token with loom's runtime role; without one, model choice reads no scorecards
